name: Proper Stable Labeled Sample Compression / No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: The stable-compression theorem applies directly; properness is an additional restriction. On the singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, $n\ge2$, the database-owned value proofs give $\lceil(n-1)/2\rceil\le\mathrm{psLSC}(\mathcal S_n)\le n-1$, while $\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal S_n)=1$ (values 1157 and 171). Therefore no universal reverse affine bound is possible. Only linear asymptotic order, not an exact psLSC formula, is used.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: theorem thm:stable-comp-low-NCTD-star.
